New logo, repeat and shuffle, a cleaner header, and plugins that never cut a value.

**Playback**
- **Repeat** button in the top row (off → all → one), key `R`.
- **Shuffle** button (key `S`). Previous goes back through the tracks you actually heard.
- Transport remembers the position of the last track and resumes there.
- Click the time to switch between elapsed and remaining time.
- Drop several files or a whole folder: they become the playlist.
- Media keys work, and the track shows up in the system media overlay (Windows) and in Control Center / Now Playing (macOS), with title, artist and cover.
- Opening a file while Transport runs brings the window to the front, even when it was minimised.

**Look**
- New logo (two overlapping discs) as app icon, MENU mark and in the file-type icons.
- Header: play sits in the centre of the window with previous/next and shuffle/repeat around it; volume is centred with the quick buttons. Nothing overlaps when the window gets narrow, the text gives way first.
- Quick buttons: one icon language (pin for always on top, headphones for monitor, MONO monogram, ...), slightly smaller tiles.
- VU meter keeps its look; the needle now turns around a visible fixed pivot.
- Plugins: labels and values shrink before they are cut, so a narrow slot never shows a wrong number (e.g. "12" instead of "124 BPM"). Short titles when a slot is narrow.
- Plugin browser uses 1–3 columns depending on the window width; messages appear at the bottom centre.
- Fixed a ghost of the old title when switching tracks.

**Windows**
- MENU → File icon colour…: pick a colour for the file-type icons (Auto follows light/dark mode, or any custom colour).

**Performance**
- 30 fps when Transport is in the background, nothing is analysed while minimised. MENU → Smooth animations switches between 60 and 30 fps in the foreground.
